byFeatureIndexes.physical_feature_revisions: Filtered by feature_id. Served by the primary key PRIMARY KEY(feature_id,revision) (database/sql/20-area/area.sql:39-43; implicit index physical_feature_revisions_pkey), whose leading column is feature_id.
byFeatureIndexes.usp_intake_targets: Filtered by package_id=ANY(...) and feature_id. package_id is served by UNIQUE(package_id,locator) (database/sql/95-ingestion/intake-targets.sql:37; implicit index usp_intake_targets_package_id_locator_key), leading column package_id. feature_id itself has no index on usp_intake_targets: it is filtered within each package's rows (at most 2000 targets per drafted package). No index was added.
